synopsis: The corpus identifies Rio Tinto as an evidence gap rather than a source of verified requirements or incident findings [f2599, f11205, f11273]. Chapter 3 reports that published requirement documents from Rio Tinto and seven other individual miners were not found [f2599]. Chapter 13 names autonomous haulage incidents involving Rio Tinto, Fortescue and BHP as relevant leads, but explicitly says they were not verified in the research [f11205, f11273]. These incident leads are worth checking before the real review; they should not be treated as established findings [f11273, f11205].

relations.note: Both identify the same miners’ autonomous haulage incidents as unverified research leads.
